## 443. The activity laws proved twice, derived once (OU3f)

After the laws of steps ([§442](442.md#442-the-theorems-that-read-only-activity-and-the-laws-of-steps-they-lack-ou3f)), OU3f's derivations begin, module by module, with the three activity laws [the audit](../../development/ou3f-activity-laws/AUDIT.md) found proved twice: once directly, and once by a twin, added with OU3a, that derives the same statement from a grammar law. Board rule 9 keeps the derivation and retires the direct proof ([design](../../development/ou3f-activity-laws/derivations/DESIGN.md)). The review found a fourth theorem of the same kind, so the audit is corrected: 399 of the 436 theorems reading only activity are laws of their models, not the 400 §442 gave. The finding stands: the general content this layer leaves to lift is small.

**The review, and what was taken.** One independent read-only review by a separate AI agent ([REVIEW-TWINS](../../development/ou3f-activity-laws/derivations/review/REVIEW-TWINS.md)); every finding was taken. It found the three re-proofs genuine derivations, and every statement of both modules printing as on main (143 declarations compared under `#check`).
- A live record and its home paragraph cited the two retired PatternPassing names, which an earlier search, cut short, had missed. Both now name the kept theorems.
- `ends_within` is a fourth case of the same kind. It is re-proved by the review's compiled route, and the audit row and the header's *Not connected* sentence are corrected.
- `«线内同类»` is named beside `«两端分则中有标»`, and both modules' headers follow the moves.

**Self-review.** (1) Each re-proof was checked against OU3d's second review's test: the law replaces the old induction or search, and what remains is a representation (`continuing_iff_line`, `line_back`) with its own induction. (2) The binder names were kept so that the statements print unchanged; the review compared them under `#check`. (3) A search for the consumers of a retired name must be read whole: the record was found by the review, not by the search. (4) Not done: the items in Boundary.
